method: Reconsidered the dated UvA programme groups and course contents and entry requirements before inspecting the exact frozen decision and canonical record against the workbook.
findings: The 180 EC English pathway includes Risk Theory as the selected restricted option, 30 EC approved choice, and two distinct 6 EC thesis seminar components. The first two years satisfy the 120 EC entry requirement. Probability, econometrics and empirical work precede the relevant advanced courses.

All three UCR options have the required offerings and sequence. The closest integrates economics, mathematical methods, regression and prediction. Computer vision and sequential decision methods distinguish the technical option. Banking, accounting, market research and strategy distinguish the finance and organisation option.

UvA’s insurance, time-series and specialist econometrics requirements remain separate. Reader-facing notes distinguish real partial alignments and explain the thesis components. UCR independent research is optional and outside the schedule.
